title: 23-BCV-018 — Vented soffit protection

facts.text: The variance applies to Part 9 buildings requiring solid soffits because of projections in areas of concern, typically near a property line.

Intumescent-coated vented fiberglass or metal substrate is an alternative only when tested by an SCC-accredited laboratory and documentation verifies performance equal to or greater than 11 mm plywood in Appendix A Table 1.
Installation must follow manufacturer instructions or testing documentation.
The source lists the relevant provisions as Sentences 9.10.14.5.(12), 9.10.15.5.(11), and 9.10.12.4.(2)–(3).
